title: c4-health — evidence-anchored verdicts, one per audited issue
description: Populated by the audit channel (lib/audit.mjs: auditPlan/applyVerdicts) — never by gen or check, and never network. `n` is an issue number, not a node id: one node can carry several verdicts, one per issue that touched it. `check`/`room` validate only that a verdict's evidence resolves — never the prose in `why`. Array shape (not an object keyed by issue number) so the existing hand-rolled schema walker (lib/validate.mjs, no patternProperties support) can validate it directly.
